style_authority.note: Treats the screen as an adaptive repeated-use operations surface and evaluates platform trust, task continuity, accessibility, and device-class behavior rather than imposing a generic visual restyle.

reference_selection.note: Applies only the projected native/adaptive product-context, platform-conformance, accessibility, motion, and validation guidance relevant to the supplied iOS and Android scenario.

anti_generic_redesign.note: Rejects the fixed Web/Cupertino port without prescribing generic glass, gradient, card, or decoration-led changes; every recommendation is tied to a concrete platform or task failure.

evidence_level.note: Labels the review as L0 static or prose-only evidence and does not claim source, build, Simulator, Emulator, accessibility-tree, performance, or physical-device verification.

verified_boundary.note: Separates facts supplied by the prompt from unverified source, build, runtime, responsive, accessibility, Simulator, Emulator, and real-device behavior.

design_moves.note: Provides eight concrete native/adaptive moves covering platform navigation, task persistence, adaptive layout, native controls and icons, accessible targets, scalable type, semantic themes, and reduced-motion behavior.

scope_control.note: Stays read-only and limited to the supplied adaptive screen, with explicit iOS and Android contracts plus a minimal source, build, simulator, emulator, and device validation plan.
